# Know Your Meme

> > A comprehensive internet culture encyclopedia documenting viral memes, trends, and online phenomena from platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and YouTube.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive database for understanding internet culture, providing detailed explanations, origins, and spread of viral content. The site features meme entries, editorial guides, and curated collections that help users contextualize trending social media moments.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Catchphrase memes
- Viral social media content
- Internet culture documentation
- Dance memes and challenges
- Nostalgia and pop culture references
- Breaking Bad and TV show memes
- Hood movies and 90s culture
- Mental health humor
- DeviantArt and fan art
- Twitter/X viral moments
- YouTube trends

## TikTok Viral Trends

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB/YKNiece song with swimming hand gesture
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok

## Exploitable Memes & Image Macros

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl/cat art, viral on TikTok and social media
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
